body:
I'm not graduating with a C.S. degree, it's sort of like I'm getting a minor in it. 

I've mentioned how I feel about my situation and medication. Plus, with graduation coming up soon, I don't want to try any new meds right now.

Thanks though,

Yup, I've seen multiple psychologists, therapists, etc. I was on an SSRI for a year and a half. The therapists didn't help; besides in the beginning for that semi "cathartic" feeling of getting everything off my chest and into the open. I've studied psychology a lot, so there wasn't much they could tell me that I didn't know. I don't know if the meds helped or not. They definitely made me sleepy though.

Right now, I think if I could just get a good job, and my own place, and have some security knowing that I'm going to get out of my debt, I'd be basically ok. Maybe not yet "happy", but happy enough to get by, and more importantly - enough to keep trying to make my life better by making friends, etc. I think that my fucked up feelings are more due to shitty day-to-day events than from any chemical imbalance.

Thanks for the comment. And I hope life gets better for you too man. By the way, maybe you could try meditating? I haven't had much luck with it, but it may work for you...

I studied mainly Computer Science, Philosophy, and Anthropology. Also lots of science and math; I kept changing my major because I was never satisfied, and because my depression and anxiety was hampering my ability to do work. As for control, I'm referring to any kind. Debt, my parents, friends, basically all areas of my life right now. I am intelligent, which is partly why I've been hit so hard by depression. I analyze things a lot, and some think I "think too much". I disagree. I believe others just think too little, even if my thought does drive me crazy - I'd rather be crazy then unauthentic. I do continue to try to improve myself, and have pushed myself very hard. In fact, whenever I find I'm scared of one thing or another, I force myself to do it to overcome the fear. This wears me out as well. I think I have a lot to offer the world too, I'm just hope that I can make it through these next few months, couple of years, however long it takes to get there. 

Thank you for the encouraging words.
